test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the __**underlined word.**__

The owner **__underestimated__ **the damage caused to the walls of the apartment.
solution:
The solution is **Exaggerated**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate ANTONYM for 'The owner underestimated__ the damage caused to the walls of the apartment.' is Exaggerated.
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss about *Antonyms:*
 
• Antonyms is the opposite meaning of the given word.
 
 
• For example :- Antonym of *good is bad, little is more.*
 
 
 
• *​*Antonym for **Calculated **is **unintentional**.
 
• *​*Antonym for **Charged **is **lifeless**.
 
• *​*Antonym for **Misled **is clear.
